pages.title: Using the Tea Stove
pages.text: The Tea Stove has 4 slots. After 1 item is placed in each slot, the stove processes them using campfire recipes, taking 600 ticks (30 seconds).$(br2)It can process foods and tea leaves; placing processable items needs no fuel because the stove has its own heat source. Use the GUI to insert items and watch the progress.

pages.title: Output
pages.text: When processing finishes, the products are automatically sent into the neighbouring bamboo pipe network.$(br2)If they cannot be sent, the products pop out above the Tea Stove.
